items.author: redhojelah.bsky.social
items.context: Yeah I think even if you DO want to play something in bed it should be something relaxing, like one of those word games or sth. That was my only bedtime routine because I know that would put me to sleep after a few rounds. I'm trying not to bring my tablet either so I'm not tempted to draw in bed
items.text: Short word-game rounds are a nice wind-down. Easy to stop whenever you start feeling sleepy.

items.author: kimista.bsky.social
items.context: Same. I really wish it was in Autumn. And it bothers me that games like Hello Kitty Island Adventure have events and seasons following the Northern hemisphere. It feels so wrong to be playing a game getting cozy for Winter when it's 30°c outside. I wish they'd flip it around for us.
items.text: That's a fair wish. Stardew Valley keeps its own calendar, so Autumn arrives whenever your farm gets there, whatever the real-world season is.
